intro: You are investigators in 1920s Gull Rock, where the harbour holds something old and the drowned chorus sings. Roll under skill with percentile dice: 96 or higher is a Mistake, and one-fifth of your skill or less is Flawless. Peril runs from Routine (-20) to Dire (40). Sanity is your strain; what you see costs it. Athletics covers climbing, throwing, and shooting. Brawl covers close combat. Talk covers persuasion, lies, and panic. Truth is experience; Standing is how much you have learned.

origins.name: Coastal-Born
origins.about: You grew up among salt houses, tide marks, and bad weather.
origins.gift: Gain +10 to boat, athletics, and stealth when near the water.

origins.name: Mainland Scholar
origins.about: You came from schools, hospitals, or newsrooms on the mainland.
origins.gift: Use lore as if trained for one research or reading roll each story.

origins.name: Old Stock
origins.about: Your family has lived near Gull Rock long enough to be blamed for things.
origins.gift: You know one local name, place, or old grudge; gain +10 to talk or lore with Gull Rock folk.

origins.name: Far Wind
origins.about: You came by ship or border, and you still sound like you came from elsewhere.
origins.gift: You speak another language and gain +10 to talk with outsiders.

callings.name: Physician
callings.about: A doctor who has seen too much and tries to name it.

callings.name: Reporter
callings.about: A writer chasing what Gull Rock wants buried.

callings.name: Fisherman's Widow
callings.about: You know the sea's moods and what it takes back.

callings.name: Defrocked Priest
callings.about: You stopped believing, but you still pray when the dark comes.

abilities.name: Field Triage
abilities.effect: Restore 5 Health to one wounded Investigator; if you succeed, also remove bleeding.

abilities.name: Steady Nerves
abilities.effect: Ignore shaken or frozen until the end of your next turn.

abilities.name: Press the Story
abilities.effect: An NPC reveals one hidden clue; if you fail, they clam up.

abilities.name: Unshaken Witness
abilities.effect: Take one Sanity in place of another Investigator's Sanity loss.

abilities.name: Harbour Sense
abilities.effect: You know what the tide will do next and gain +20 to dodge or stealth while moving by water.

abilities.name: Tide Walk
abilities.effect: Cross a flooded path, causeway, or slick rock without slipping.

abilities.name: Name the Prayer
abilities.effect: When the drowned chorus sings, you and allies gain +10 to resist being shaken.

abilities.name: Ward the Dark
abilities.effect: One What Answers takes -10 to its next attack.

gear.name: Storm Coat
gear.about: Oilskin coat against spray and fear.

chargen: Choose an origin and take its starting stats and gift.
Choose a calling and take its gear and abilities.
Move up to 20 stat points between your four stats; no stat may be above 70.
Assign 30 skill points among the skills listed by your calling, plus any others you can explain; no skill may start above 60.
Set Sanity to 6. The maximum is 8. At 3 or less, take -10 to all rolls; at 1 or less, take -20.
Set Health to 10 plus body divided by 10, rounded down.
Name your Investigator, write one thing they want, and track Truth spent on your Standing.

pregens.name: Dr. Ada Fenwick
pregens.look: Plain coat, steady hands, tired eyes.
pregens.want: Find out who signed the hospital orders.

pregens.name: Sam Oakes
pregens.look: Fedora, ink-stained cuffs, notebook in hand.
pregens.want: Get the Gull Rock story into the morning edition.

pregens.name: Maren Thorne
pregens.look: Sea-rough hands and a black shawl.

pregens.name: Father Eamon Locke
pregens.look: Frayed collar and a bruised cross.
pregens.want: Prove the old faith was not madness.
